mario kart world - nintendo switch 2.name: Mario Kart World - Nintendo Switch 2
mario kart world - nintendo switch 2.description:
Ready your wheels for a brand-new Mario Kart game exclusively for the Nintendo Switch 2 system—with a world of interconnected courses to race through.

The whole world is your racetrack in this massive evolution of the Mario Kart series!

The courses you race on are all connected in a seamless world. Drive the paths between them to traverse mountains, forests, cities, and more. Take in the sprawling vistas as you explore at your own pace in Free Roam—or watch how a sudden shift in the weather can mix up a dead heat in a tense Grand Prix. Ride on rails, jump off walls, skim across water, and more as you race for the finish line. Master these new maneuvers and you might cut down your time to the finish line!

Race online across modes with up to 23 other players, or talk with friends using GameChat as you race or roam.

Go full speed with series-new drivers, vehicles, courses, outfits, items, and more! Race on brand-new courses, as well as familiar ones that have been reimagined with additional routes and other details. Stick with your favorite driver or broaden your horizons—some of the new additions might surprise you! (Is that Cow?!)

Race from one course to another through interconnected paths that span the world. Traverse mountains, forests, cities, and more—with shifting weather patterns and a day/night cycle. Ride on rails, jump off walls, skim across water, and more as you race for the finish line.

Take on the adrenaline-packed Knockout Tour—a fierce 24-driver elimination mode.

Play Grand Prix with up to 24 drivers.

Explore courses at your own pace and wander the world to discover fun surprises in Free Roam.

Internet, Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features, including GameChat. Not available in all countries.
